instruction: Candid documentary medium full shot from a low angle of a ballet studio with concrete walls and wooden barres. The young girl in a black leotard (R1) lies on her stomach on the floor, lifting her chest and extending her arms forward with a neutral expression. Kneeling behind her, the blonde instructor in a black long-sleeve top (R2) gently guides the young girl's arms by placing her hands on the girl's upper arms. Soft natural light filters through the background windows, illuminating the neutral-toned room and casting soft shadows on the floor.
